text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
—— At last,
the end of Hallowe'en is upon us.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
The time is here.
Offer up your pure and precious soul to
me, 
and fulfill your century-old desire. …Now,
where is my soul!

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: …… The soul I am to offer……

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: …… I don't have it.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
… Huh? Do you really think I don't know? 
I know you have it.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
…… I do, but ―― 
Ah, I get it now.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
Because I experienced being touched. 
I've come to understand… the shape of this
heart.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
… I am… 
… I am ending our deal.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with you?
After waiting alone for a century, 
you suddenly don't want to know your reason
for existence!?

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter anymore. 
I… It doesn't matter who or what I am.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
You're still a monster, you know? 
Neither alive nor dead, not even a name!

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
—— "Friend"… 
My name is the "Friend" of that girl,
and that's enough.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
…… Haha!
Was it such a joy for you to have been
entertained? 
You seem to have forgotten that you could
only enter the village on Hallowe'en.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
Once your true identity is revealed,
you'll not only be alone again,
but shunned as well.
And that girl who got involved 
with you might face consequences too ——

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
I will leave the village. Demon,
it's time 
for us to part ways here. Farewell……

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: …… Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you! 
Guess what,
I'm finally going on a journey!

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Will you come with me? 
We promised, remember?

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: … Yes, but I ——

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
You're my friend,
that's all that matters! 
The memories we're going to make together
will prove it.

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Let's make lots of memories together. 
We'll see so many things in the world, 
… and experience so many more!

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
—— Yes… 
My… friend…

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
…… Farewell. Farewell. 
To become "myself",
I must say goodbye to "myself".

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
—— To the lonely "Mechanical Doll",
farewell. 
Farewell……

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
… Speaking of it sounds cliché,
just another mundane farewell. 
Tch, I've told such a dull story ——

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
……? Hey, weirdo. Where did you go? 
……… So, as always,
that's how it is. I'm so……

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
Fret not, my friend,
for I've lingered in this midst,
an audience enthralled. Your narrative,
enchanting in its essence, eclipses 
even the grandest sagas of inebriated
valor!

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
In the wake of the demon's usurpation,
as the bard's essence 
wanes,
I shall willingly take part to continue the
ending!

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text: …… Continue the ending?

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
Aye, I am familiar with the entirety of that
tale. Its continuation, 
and its conclusion.
My presence in this village is a testament
to my quest to fathom your story's depths.

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
—— Nestled beneath a sea of clovers,
it was discovered. 
Solitary, yet radiating a serene demeanor.

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
"I've beheld a century's worth of this world".
Its voice, timeworn and coarse,
reverberated.
But as the final moments drew near, 
a single lingering worry it whispered into
the air ——

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
The demon, a lone soul,
treads twixt life and death's thread. 
Through the ages,
he persists…… like a visitor in a strange 
mansion, loneliness widespread.

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
So I forged a solemn pledge with him. 
―― Aye, dear friend, my journey to this 
village was destined to be in your name.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text: Friend……

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A bard and a demon touring through hell
together… 
It has quite an intriguing ring to it.
In truth, I was 
getting weary of merely composing poetry in
the tavern.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
…… Do you know what it means to go down to
hell with me? 
You'll die and roam a world filled with
screams… for eternity.

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
Life is transient anyway. It lacks purpose —
God didn't assign 
one. That's why I prefer hell.
I can ascribe it my own value.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
… Hah. 
Bards are unquestionably crazy.

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
Not exactly. I'm the one who's eccentric.
Doesn't that make a 
fitting friend for you?
Embracing the never-ending monotony, 
willingly plunging myself into it.

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text:
Now, my friend,
let's take a leisurely stroll.
Hallowe'en for this 
year is coming to an end.
Before another tranquil day begins, 
let's bid farewell to tonight's stage……

text_block_list.name: [Bard]
text_block_list.text: —— Adieu!
(―― Clap Clap……!)

(Clap Clap Clap Clap Clap Clap Clap
Clap……!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
… Uuugh, I'm freakin' exhausted. 
How much longer is this going to go on
for?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Forever, Shakur! In the memories 
of one and all,
this applause is fixin' to linger.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Kris S, what 'bout you? 
What's stirrin' inside of you at this
moment?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I… don't know how to describe it…
